# Glossary

The terms this project uses, A to Z. Each is defined once, in `terms.yaml` beside this page.

## Newer

Of two releases, the one whose version number sorts later, as `packaging` compares them: `1.10` is newer than `1.9`.

Also called: later (maintainers).

See also: [Release](#release).

## Release

A version of a package, named by its version number, such as `1.2.0`.

Also called: version.

See also: [Newer](#newer).

## Other names

Each other name, and the term it means.

- later (maintainers): [Newer](#newer)
- version: [Release](#release)
